part1_forecasts.statement: There is a 78% chance that the U.S. Commerce Department will issue at least one additional Section 232 enforcement adjustment targeting semiconductor manufacturing equipment derivatives before February 2028.

resolution_criteria.source: The White House Press Releases / BIS

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: unit: federal register notices or presidential proclamations; status: official enactment; window: through February 1, 2028; excludes: routine administrative extensions without new trade restrictions.
